name: Nelson Mandela
summary: Nelson Mandela became a central figure in South Africa's struggle against apartheid and its transition to democracy.
sensitiveContextNote: Discuss Mandela with historical context, including apartheid, imprisonment, political struggle, and reconciliation.

facts.text: Mandela became South Africa's first democratically elected president in 1994.
facts.context: His election marked a turning point from apartheid toward a constitutional democracy with broader political participation.
